description:
Get a company's sole-shareholder network from links with no ending
identified in available BORME publications. Links do not establish
current ownership, control or a legal group. Use it for identified sole
shareholders or connected companies; use group_history for events. Name
lookup: multiple matches return {ambiguous: true, candidates}; none
return {error, suggested_companies}.

Returns {company_slug, parents (nearest first), top_parent_slug,
members: [{slug, name, province, status, owner_slug, depth, link_kind,
since, evidence: {event_id, date, text (excerpt, max 600 chars)}}],
unresolved, truncated, note}. The highest member has owner_slug,
link_kind, since and evidence null. Names not matched to exactly one
company appear as printed in unresolved; do not treat them as resolved
companies. Max 200 members. include_directors adds director links, not
members. Empty parents does not rule out control or a legal group.

Read-only. Pro plan; X-API-Key header.

company.description: Company slug, e.g. vaz-metales-sl (from search_companies), or a name of at least 3 letters or digits, e.g. "Mercadona".
company.title: Company

include_directors.description: Optional, one of true or false (default false), e.g. true to add legal persons appointed as directors of members and the companies a member administers, marked as director links; a director link alone does not make a company a member of the group.
include_directors.title: Include Directors

name: company_group
title: A company's identified sole-shareholder network
